Drop Rates When Using an Alteration Stone

When an Alteration Stone is used, all values applied are selected with equal probability.

Example

Item Name1%2%3%4%5%
Alteration Stone (Attack Power +1-3%)33.3333%33.3333%33.3333%--
Alteration Stone (Attack Power +2-4%)-33.3333%33.3333%33.3333%-
Alteration Stone (Attack Power +3-5%)--33.3333%33.3333%33.3333%

Additional Blessing Drop Rates by Equipment

These are the drop rates for the Additional Blessings granted when equipment is obtained from Junk.
*Additional Blessings applied to a single piece of equipment do not stack.

Additional Blessing drop rates for bonus equipment are listed here.

Additional Blessing Value Drop Rates by Equipment Rank

These are the drop rates for the Additional Blessing Values granted when equipment is obtained from Junk.
■ For Rank 1-5 equipment, this varies depending on:
1. The Quality of the obtained equipment
2. The Additional Blessings granted

Additional Blessing Value Drop Rates When Using Lesser Full Alteration Stones

These are the drop rates for the Additional Blessing Values granted when Lesser Full Alteration Stone are used on equipment of Grade 2 or higher. These rates apply only when the conditions for each of the Applicable Additional Blessing Slots listed below are met. In all other cases, Additional Blessing Value Drop Rates by Equipment Rank will apply.

[Applicable Additional Blessing Slots]
- Additional Blessing Slot 1: Initial equipment Grade 2 or higher and enhancement level +5 or higher
- Additional Blessing Slot 2: Initial equipment Grade 3 or higher and enhancement level +10 or higher
- Additional Blessing Slot 3: Initial equipment Grade 4 or higher and enhancement level +15 or higher
- Additional Blessing Slot 4: Initial equipment Grade 5 or higher and enhancement level +20 or higher

*This does not apply to Grade 1 equipment that has become Grade 2 after enhancement.

Additional Blessing Value Drop Rates When Using Full Alteration Stones

These are the drop rates for the Additional Blessing Values granted when Full Alteration Stones are used on equipment of Grade 2 or higher. These rates apply only when the conditions for each of the Applicable Additional Blessing Slots listed below are met. In all other cases, Additional Blessing Value Drop Rates by Equipment Rank will apply.

[Applicable Additional Blessing Slots]
- Additional Blessing Slot 1: Initial equipment Grade 2 or higher and enhancement level +5 or higher
- Additional Blessing Slot 2: Initial equipment Grade 3 or higher and enhancement level +10 or higher
- Additional Blessing Slot 3: Initial equipment Grade 4 or higher and enhancement level +15 or higher
- Additional Blessing Slot 4: Initial equipment Grade 5 or higher and enhancement level +20 or higher

*This does not apply to Grade 1 equipment that has become Grade 2 after enhancement.
